title: Constructible subsets cut down to a closed subset stay constructible
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the intersection of a constructible subset with a closed subset is constructible in that closed subset (author lemma at source lines 2872-2878, label lemma-intersect-constructible-with-closed). The proof (source lines 2880-2890) reduces to retrocompactness of the trace of a retrocompact open, adjoins the complement of the closed subset to a quasi-compact open so that the trace is unchanged, and uses closedness inside a quasi-compact open (proof lines 2880-2889). The adjoining step is the substance. H3.
